info.title: search-bsp
info.description: HTTP proxy tool that forwards HTTP requests to external endpoints. Send any HTTP request by providing the target URI and request content/body. This is useful for making HTTP calls to external APIs or services. Example: Search BSP information by providing the search endpoint URI and query parameters in the request body.

post.description: Forwards HTTP requests to any external endpoint. Provide the target HTTP_URI (complete URL with protocol, host, path, and query parameters) and HTTP_request_content (JSON body or form data as a string). The proxy will execute the request and return the response. Example: To search BSP data, set HTTP_URI to 'https://api.example.com/search?query=BSP' and HTTP_request_content to '{"filters": {"category": "products"}}'

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: `2016-10-01` is the most common generally available version

HTTP_URI.description: Complete URI for the HTTP request including protocol, host, path, and query parameters. Example: 'https://api.contoso.com/v1/search?q=term&limit=10'

HTTP_request_content.description: Request body content as a JSON string. Use this to send POST data, filters, or parameters. For GET requests, this can be empty or omitted. Example: '{"filters": {"category": "electronics", "inStock": true}, "sort": "price_asc"}'

sig.description: The SHA 256 hash of the entire request URI with an internal key.
sig.name: sig
